cninfo.historical_availability: CNINFO calendar day is conservatively available at 23:59:59.999999 Asia/Shanghai
cninfo.same_day_grouping: One symbol plus availability day plus materiality category becomes one immutable event package retaining at most six titles and announcement identifiers.

gdelt_daily_events.retention: URL-derived headline plus GDELT event metadata summary only; no article fetch and no article body
gdelt_daily_events.historical_availability: DATEADDED has day-only resolution; the daily archive is conservatively available at 00:00 UTC on the second following day, after one full uncertain publication day.
gdelt_daily_events.download_rule: Read into bounded memory, reject above 16MiB compressed or 160MiB uncompressed, never persist the archive

selection_rule.trade_and_macro_geo_gate: Require China, Hong Kong, Taiwan, Japan, Korea or United States actor/location evidence.
selection_rule.bad_slug_gate: Reject URL headlines with fewer than 12 alphabetic characters or three words.
selection_rule.quality_exclusions: investment promotion, consumer-device reviews, telecom crime, private tariff litigation, polling and food quarantine

gdelt_daily_events.authority_limit: Seven-day review rejected this source as a direct feature source. Discovery metadata cannot independently trigger a buy, replace official facts, or satisfy the professional-news layer.

promotion_gates.next_gate: Materialize the checkpointed CNINFO full-window official-fact dataset under the root hard cap and qualify a professional-news primary source before any external-weight backtest.
